kpis.signal: Combustibles résilient, US momentum + price/mix positifs

kpis.explanation_en: Historical cash cow. Volumes in structural decline but pricing power keeps revenue modestly growing.

kpis.signal: Smokeless = 13% revenu total BAT, objectif 50% en 2035

kpis.explanation_en: BAT's strategic transition: replace declining combustibles with growing smokeless. Long-term lever.
